findings.issue: הַמִּשְׁכָּן is a definite common noun (H4908), not a locked proper name; mishkán leaves the lemma untranslated.
אֲחֹרֵי is a preposition (behind/after). espalda turns it into a noun, the back.
וְסֶרַח is anarthrous absolute; el adds a definite article the token does not mark.
בִּירִיעֹת הָאֹהֶל is a definite construct chain. en cortinas leaves that plural indefinite.

notes: Number, gender, and the paired surplus roots otherwise match the tokens.
